groups.label: Mixed / Neutral
groups.explanation:
⚠️ Material bearish change. Treasury yields remain the main pressure point, with the 2Y at 4.827% and the 10Y at 5.273%. Semiconductor momentum remains an important equity confirmation: SOXX has risen for 4 consecutive sessions. QQQ is +0.68% over five sessions and +3.00% versus its 20-day average.

The Nasdaq Setup is mixed/neutral (-10/100, 58% confidence, deteriorating ↓). The current balance is persistent semiconductor momentum on the supportive side versus elevated/rising Treasury yields as the main headwind.

Near-term risk is concentrated in the 10Y yield is above the 5.05% headwind threshold at 5.273%. Improvement in these conditions would strengthen the setup; further deterioration would reduce conviction. Elevated consolidation risk is reducing conviction in the directional setup.
